intent: Dark-first product hero: headline, sub and CTAs above a markup-drawn mail app window that starts tilted back 22deg and flattens as it scrolls into place, with every part of the window choreographed in and its counts ticking up.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (container queries, including a named @container/win; CSS variables for theme tokens)
stack.animation: motion/react: useScroll on the window frame, useSpring, useTransform, useInView, animate() into motion values, variants with a custom start time

layout.stage: mt 56/80px; perspective 1200px wrapper with bottom mask (#000 52% -> transparent 96%)
layout.window: radius 14/18px; title bar 44px; body 440/520/600px; sidebar 212px (>= @4xl/win) with the overnight card directly under the three triage folders; list 340-372px (full width < @2xl/win); detail flex-1 (>= @2xl/win)

typography.app: one scale: mono 10px labels, 11.5px meta, 12.5px UI, 13px rows, 13.5px/1.65 prose, subject 19-21px semibold; all figures tabular-nums

color.approach: monochrome first; every tone is ink at an opacity; one accent prop
color.accent: prop, default #f2c46d, meaning 'Tern prepared this': eyebrow dot, the dot inside Draft marks, the dot before 'Drafted by Tern', the overnight meter fill. Never text or fills.
color.avatars: one neutral grey for everyone; label swatches differ by grey weight

motion.scroll: useScrollFlatten hook: useScroll target window frame, offset ['start end','start 20%']; rescaled by p0 = min(0.85, (vh - top)/(0.8 vh)) so it starts fully tilted on load
motion.spring: stiffness 170, damping 32, mass 0.5; jump on first value
motion.mapping: rotateX (1-p)*tilt, scale 0.94->1, y 24->0px, origin 50% 0%; spotlight opacity 0.22->1; top edge light 0.15->0.4->1
motion.entrance: one T timeline. Copy: eyebrow 0, headline 0.06 + muted 0.13, body 0.20, CTAs 0.26/0.31 (opacity, y 12, blur 8px, 600ms). Window on its own useInView (15%): shell blur-fade 0.28, title bar 0.38, sidebar items every 25ms from 0.44, list header 0.46, rows every 45ms from 0.52 (selected bar draws scaleY after its row), subject 0.54, sender 0.59, body 0.60+, draft card 0.72, draft text 0.80+ (y 8, blur 6px, 500ms)
motion.numbers: folder counts, list count and 'done of triaged' count up from 0 over 700ms with a 3px blur clearing; motion values only, no per-frame setState
motion.progress: overnight meter scaleX 0 -> done/triaged at 0.92s for 700ms, after its card lands
motion.reducedMotion: window flat, spotlight full, 150ms opacity fades, numbers and meter set instantly

responsive.phone: CTAs stacked full width; window shows the list only and choreographs when scrolled into view

accessibility: window is a figure with role img and a descriptive aria-label; its contents are illustrative
CTAs are links with a 2px ink focus-visible ring offset 4px
reduced motion shows the window flat with opacity-only fades
no scroll hijacking: the page scrolls normally
accent is never the only carrier of meaning: Draft marks are labelled

content.headline: Your inbox, triaged before coffee.
content.body: Tern reads the overnight pile, sorts it into Reply, Read later and Ignored, and drafts the boring answers in your voice. You just press send.
content.app: 7 threads (Priya Raman: renewal 40 seats; Jonas Lindqvist: offer letter; Halcyon Capital: Q3 update; ...), overnight 182 of 251 sorted, open thread with a reply drafted by Tern and Northwind_order_40.pdf attached

avoid: coloured traffic lights and hue-per-person avatars
gold text, gold chips or gold fills; the accent is a dot or a meter
glow or gradient borders around the window
the window popping in as one block
progress filling before its card lands
